label: Говорить
description: A full conjugation deck for говорить: present persons, past, future, imperative, and the suppletive perfective сказать.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Говорю' is the standard -ю form of говорить. 'Немного' softens the claim and 'по-русски' names the language. A core identity sentence for any learner.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Говоришь' shows the -ишь ending typical of говорить. 'Всегда' and 'очень тихо' build a natural complaint about a habit of speech.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Говорит' is the core -ит form of говорить. The subject 'мой брат' and object 'правду' make a complete, common observation about character.

missions.phrase: Сейчас мы говорим о новой книге.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Говорим' reinforces the -им plural ending. 'О новой книге' adds the о + prepositional complement; 'сейчас' anchors the ongoing discussion.
Strategic focus: Polite or plural present. 'Говорите' trains the respectful -ите form of говорить. 'Слишком медленно сегодня' makes a natural remark useful in live conversation.

missions.phrase: Дети на улице говорят очень громко.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Говорят' closes the person ladder with the -ят ending. Subject 'дети на улице' and 'очень громко' complete the present-tense set vividly.

missions.phrase: Я часто говорю со старым другом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Present, instrumental government. 'Говорю' is first-person singular. 'Со старым другом' shows the с + instrumental pattern for talking with someone; 'часто' marks frequency.

missions.phrase: Дома мы редко говорим о работе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Present, prepositional government. 'Говорим' is first-person plural. 'О работе' shows the о + prepositional topic pattern; 'дома' and 'редко' frame a relatable everyday habit.
Strategic focus: Past, masculine. 'Говорил' is the masculine singular past with the -л suffix of говорить. 'Вчера' and 'очень тихо' anchor time and manner.
Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Говорила' adds the feminine -ла ending. 'Мне' is the dative listener and 'правду' the accusative object, contrasting cleanly with the masculine past.
Strategic focus: Past, neuter. 'Говорило' is the neuter -ло form agreeing with neuter 'радио'. 'Старое' and 'слишком громко' give the rarer neuter subject useful, natural practice.

missions.phrase: Вчера они долго говорили о книге.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past, plural. 'Говорили' is the plural -ли past, shared by all genders. 'Долго' and 'о книге' complete the past-tense set with a natural prepositional topic.

missions.phrase: Я буду говорить медленно и чётко.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective future, singular. 'Буду' is the auxiliary building the compound future; 'говорить' stays in the infinitive. 'Медленно и чётко' drills the буду + infinitive pattern.

missions.phrase: На уроке мы будем говорить по-русски.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective future, plural. 'Будем' is the first-person plural auxiliary and 'говорить' stays infinitive. 'На уроке' and 'по-русски' isolate the compound future structure.
Strategic focus: Imperative, singular. 'Говори' is the informal command form of говорить. 'Пожалуйста' and 'немного тише' soften the request to one familiar listener.
Strategic focus: Imperative, polite or plural. 'Говорите' is the respectful command of говорить. 'Пожалуйста' and 'чуть медленнее' form a practical request, mirroring the singular imperative.
Strategic focus: Perfective imperative. 'Скажи' comes from the suppletive perfective сказать; the stem changes completely (говор- → скаж-). 'Прошу тебя' makes a complete, urgent appeal.

missions.phrase: Я наконец сказал ему всю правду.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. 'Сказал' is the suppletive perfective of говорить, marking a completed act with the стем скаж-/сказ-. 'Наконец' and 'всю правду' complete the moment.

Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person. 'Скажет' is the simple future of suppletive сказать, needing no auxiliary. It contrasts with буду + говорить; 'ответ завтра' fixes the completed event.

missions.phrase: Я скажу тебе об этом позже.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person. 'Скажу' is the suppletive simple future, completed in one step. 'Тебе' is the dative recipient and 'об этом позже' the deferred topic.

Strategic focus: Perfective поговорить. 'Поговорим' is the first-person plural future of the delimitative perfective ('let us have a talk'). 'Давай' frames a friendly proposal; contrast the по- prefix with bare говорить.
